provenanceNote: Hand-authored seed, provenance-preserving, per AI_LIBRARY_ASHURBANIPAL_PLAN.md. PRIORITY article of the Economics 101 series — the previously-missing Buy Wall / Sell Wall reference. Grounded in the repo's OWN order-book readers so the concepts connect to live tools: detectWalls/wallSummary (integrations/liquidity-walls.mjs, 5x-median threshold + phantomX flag), spread/detectPaperWall (integrations/order-book-spread.mjs, spoof/paper-wall detection), and market-depth.mjs (depth + whale-concentration). Ties walls to real liquidity and to protocol-owned-liquidity buybacks (existing UIA-lineage article). HARD compliance baked in and footered: walls are market mechanics, NEVER a buy/sell signal; not investment advice; no price prediction; no how-to-pump. Written 2026-08-25.
